title: Velo 1.6: the glass update
summary: This is Velo 1.6. The whole launcher and every in-game menu are glass now, with a new title screen in space, a new R-Shift menu, a new emote wheel, new sounds, Tier Tagger and much more. Go through the list: each item says where to look and what to try. Something broken or ugly? Press "Broken - report it", drag in screenshots, clips or logs and send. Answers show up under "My reports". Please keep it private until the release.
changes: Launcher: glass look everywhere, calm page transitions, loading placeholders, party lobby with chat, arcade, launcher tour on your first Home visit
Title screen: new Play Deck layout, space scene with an astronaut, Continue shows your last server
R-Shift: glass drawer that is also the HUD editor and grows into the full menu, with a short tour the first time; Theme settings
Emote wheel (launcher and game): hold the key, point in a direction, let go. Cloak and wings now move with your body
New interface sounds in launcher and game
Full Bright is real full bright now (26.x and 1.21.11)
Tier Tagger (PvPTiers / SubTiers) with a hold-G ring, hearts damage flash in your colour
Store: new bundle cards. Log viewer for running games. Setup guide fixes. New Windows installer look
Velo Rewind and Velo Turbo on 1.21.11, account switcher, Velo Browser with incognito
Reports from the tester window go straight to the team's tracker

test.title: Home
test.how: Open Home. No greeting text, the Play button only says Play, server chips under it are centred. If a sale is running, its strip sits at the very top. Does anything look cut off?

test.title: Switching pages
test.how: Click through Home, Profiles, Locker, Store, Friends, Settings a few times. Do panels flicker grey/red or jump? Does the left sidebar change right away when you switch the theme in Settings?

test.title: Setup guide + launcher tour
test.how: On a fresh install, go through the setup guide: are all toggles and buttons readable? On your first Home visit after it, does the tour start? Nothing overlapping or off-centre?

test.title: Switching accounts
test.how: Switch the account in the launcher. Does only your player/name update instead of the whole window rebuilding or flickering?

test.title: Running game and its log
test.how: Start a game and open it from Home > Running. Is the log readable, are warnings and errors coloured, does scrolling stay smooth?

test.title: Store bundles
test.how: Store > Bundles. Do the new cards look right and show what's inside?

test.title: Loading placeholders
test.how: Open Locker, Media (screenshots) and Profiles right after starting the launcher. Do you see soft grey placeholders while things load instead of empty spots?

test.title: Your player on Home
test.how: Start the launcher. Does your player wave once? Is the head or any cloak/aura cut off while it moves? Does the aura's ground ring sit at the feet?

test.title: Party lobby
test.how: Invite a friend (the + button next to online friends on Home). Do they appear next to you in 3D with their cloak, wings and aura, wave when they join and wave + fade when they leave? Do you both move out of sync?

test.title: Party chat + leaving
test.how: In a party, write in the chat bottom right on Home. Does it arrive at your friend? Then press Leave in its header - are you out of the party?

test.title: Emotes on Home
test.how: HOLD B on Home, move the mouse towards an emote (you don't need to be on it) and let go. Does it play? Do cloak and wings move with the body, also in a backflip?

test.title: Velo World / Snake / Blockfall
test.how: On Home, click on an empty spot, then press W, A, S, D or an arrow key. Does the game take the whole window and the launcher fade away? Leave the game - does everything come back? In a party: leave the party while playing - is your player gone for the others?

test.title: Friends and chat
test.how: Friends page: open a chat, switch between friends quickly. Does anything flicker or show letters instead of faces? Does a chat open at the newest message without jumping?

test.title: Locker
test.how: Click through cloaks and outfits in the Locker. Does the 3D preview stay put instead of reloading on every click?

test.title: Store
test.how: Store with the Monochrome theme: is the Velo+ tab readable? Does "Unlock everything" fit? Claim free coins in the rewards strip if there are any.

test.title: Customize > In-game look
test.how: Velo+ Customize > In-game look: change accent, glass darkness, blur and corners. Start the game - do the in-game menus use your settings?

test.title: Discover / partner servers
test.how: Open Discover. Does LuckySMP show a real player count (not "Offline")?

test.title: Changing Minecraft version
test.how: On a profile, open the version picker and select another version. Is the Switch button first, the text after it?

test.title: This Tester window
test.how: Report a bug / idea: drag a screenshot, a clip and a .txt/.log file onto the page, send it. Open My reports - is it there with its number? Reply to it once.

test.title: New title screen
test.how: Start the game. Continue strip with your last server at the top, Singleplayer / Multiplayer, the bar (Realms, Mods, Rewind, Store, Discover), Options / Quit, small icons, your account bottom left. Is anything cut off, overlapping, or is a mod's button missing?

test.title: Space scene
test.how: Watch the title screen for 30 seconds. Does the astronaut turn smoothly without a jump when the loop starts over? Any stutter?

test.title: Account list
test.how: Click your account bottom left on the title screen. Does the list open above it and can you switch accounts (if you have more than one in the launcher)?

test.title: R-Shift menu
test.how: In a world press R-Shift (the first time a short tour explains it). Grow the panel into the full menu and back, open a module's settings, drag a HUD module out. Smooth? FPS still fine while it's open?

test.title: Edit HUD
test.how: Full R-Shift menu > Edit HUD. Does the side panel slide away so you have the whole screen? Bring it back with the tab on the edge.

test.title: Theme settings
test.how: R-Shift > Settings > Theme: change accent colour, glass darkness, blur and roundness. Do all menus change right away?

test.title: Pause menu
test.how: Press Esc in a world. Is only the area behind the glass panels blurred, the rest of the game clear?

test.title: Emote wheel
test.how: HOLD your emote key (default B), move the mouse towards an emote and let go. Does it play without clicking? Does text ever spill out? Does your cloak follow a backflip without snapping?

test.title: Tier Tagger
test.how: Turn on Tier Tagger (it's off by default). On a PvP server, are tiers shown above heads and in the tab list? Look at a player and hold G - does the ring with all their tiers show up? Try "Show my own tier".

test.title: Hearts
test.how: Hearts module with your own colour: take damage. Is the flash a lighter version of your colour (not Minecraft's white/red)?

test.title: Clips
test.how: Play for at least 5 minutes, then save a clip (F8) a few times in a row. Do you get full-length clips every time? Open one: are Back / Folder / Share / Delete readable, does the player work?

test.title: Custom Skybox
test.how: R-Shift > Custom Skybox. Turn around slowly - is there a line where the sky picture wraps around?

test.title: Full Bright
test.how: At night or in a cave toggle Full Bright. Is it really fully bright (not a night-vision tint)? Any flicker? Please try it on 1.21.11 and 26.2.

test.title: Interface sounds
test.how: Click through menus, toggle modules, open/close R-Shift and the pause menu. Anything annoying, too loud, doubled or missing?

test.title: Continue on the title screen
test.how: Join a server, quit the game, start again. Does Continue show the right server name and icon, and does Play connect you there?

test.title: HUD Style
test.how: Set HUD Style to Glass. Do Keystrokes, Mouse Buttons and Server Display look right and centred?

test.title: Velo Browser
test.how: Open the Velo Browser, log in to a site, close and reopen the game - still logged in? Try the incognito toggle (purple bar).

test.title: Velo Rewind on 1.21.11
test.how: Only on 1.21.11: record a few minutes with Velo Rewind, open the replay, scrub and export a short video.

test.title: Cloaks
test.how: Wear a Velo cloak. Is your Minecraft cape gone under it? Is any cloak listed twice in the Locker?

test.title: Game start
test.how: Start the game a few times. Faster than before? Anything black, missing or crashing?

test.title: Performance on 1.21.11
test.how: Only on 1.21.11: play on a busy server or near farms. FPS compared to before?

test.title: Low Latency Mode
test.how: R-Shift > Low Latency Mode on, play a bit. Does aiming feel more direct? A small FPS drop is expected.

test.title: Changing keybinds
test.how: Velo keybinds: type in the search, click a keybind and press a letter. Does the letter end up in the search box?
